title: 第4章 凡尔赛大师
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
方远站在讲台上，目光不疾不徐地扫过全班。

    他的气息沉稳内敛，安槐感知了一下，凝元中期，作为高中班主任来说，绰绰有余。

    “第一堂课，不讲虚的，自我介绍。”方远的声音不大，但教室每个角落都听得清清楚楚，“姓名，淬体境界，一句话概括自己。第一排开始。”

    简单粗暴。

    第一排的学生陆续站起来。

    “我叫张浩然，淬体三重，家父张家旁支……”

    “我叫李明月，淬体二重，希望三年后考上好的武道大学。”

    “我叫赵啸天，淬体四重！我的目标是成为青岚城最强！”

    这位赵同学说完，声音还在发抖，脸红到了脖子根，教室里有人没憋住笑。

    方远面无表情地点头：“下一个。”

    轮到林落雪。

    她缓缓站起来，双手交握在身前，睫毛低垂了一瞬，再抬起那双含水的大眼睛。

    “大家好，我叫林落雪，淬体二重。我……有点紧张，不太会说话，希望大家不要嫌弃我。”

    声音轻柔得像初春细雨落在瓦片上。

    教室里立刻响起一片善意的笑声和安慰。

    “没事没事，大家都紧张。”

    “林同学别怕，咱班氛围特别好。”

    安槐没动，手指在书页上轻轻滑过。

    【情绪分析：教室内好感度正在向“林落雪”集中。她这段表演我给九分，扣一分怕她骄傲，另外宿主你注意没，她说淬体二重，但我检测到的气息波动至少三重。】

    安槐心里“嗯”了一声。

    藏实力，第一天就开始布局。

    聪明人。

    轮到苏念念。

    她站起来，椅子被推得“嘎”一声响。

    “苏念念，淬体四重。”她叉着腰，目光扫了一圈全班，嘴角挂着张扬的笑，“一句话？行！我说话直，不喜欢拐弯抹角，谁要是觉得我哪句话不好听，可以当面说，别在背后嘀咕。”

    教室安静了一秒。

    有人小声说：“好飒。”

    方远嘴角动了一下，看不出是想笑还是想叹气。“坐下吧。”

    苏念念一屁股坐回去，扭头朝安槐挑了挑眉。

    安槐朝她竖了个大拇指。
content_en:
Fang Yuan stood on the podium, his eyes scanning the whole class unhurriedly.

His aura was calm and restrained. An Huai felt it. In the middle stage of Ningyuan, it was more than enough for a high school class teacher.

"First class, don't talk nonsense, introduce yourself." Fang Yuan's voice was not loud, but it could be heard clearly from every corner of the classroom. "Name, body tempering realm, summarize yourself in one sentence. Starting from the first row."

Simple and crude.

The students in the first row stood up one after another.

"My name is Zhang Haoran, I am at the third level of body tempering, and I am a branch of my father's Zhang family..."

"My name is Li Mingyue, I am at the second level of body tempering. I hope to be admitted to a good martial arts university in three years."

"My name is Zhao Xiaotian, and I am at the fourth level of body tempering! My goal is to become the strongest in Qinglan City!"

After this classmate Zhao finished speaking, his voice was still trembling, his face was red to the base of his neck, and someone in the classroom couldn't hold back his laughter.

Fang Yuan nodded expressionlessly: "Next."

It was Lin Luoxue's turn.

She stood up slowly, clasped her hands in front of her, lowered her eyelashes for a moment, and then raised her big, watery eyes.

"Hello everyone, my name is Lin Luoxue, I am at the second level of body tempering. I am...a little nervous and I don't know how to speak. I hope you won't dislike me."

The sound was as soft as the drizzle falling on the tiles in early spring.

The classroom immediately burst into laughter and comfort.

"It's okay, it's okay, everyone is nervous."

"Don't be afraid, Mr. Lin, the atmosphere in our class is very good."

An Huai didn't move, his fingers lightly slid across the page.

[Emotional analysis: The favorability in the classroom is concentrating towards "Lin Luoxue".I give this performance of hers nine points, and deduct one point for fear of her being proud. Also, did you notice the host? She said the body tempering was at the second level, but the aura fluctuations I detected were at least three levels.】

An Huai said "hmm" in his heart.

Hide your strength and start planning on the first day.

Smart people.

It's Su Niannian's turn.

She stood up and the chair was pushed with a creak.

"Su Niannian, fourth level of body tempering." She put her hands on her hips, glanced around the class, and said with a flamboyant smile, "One sentence? Okay! I speak straightforwardly and don't like to beat around the bush. If anyone thinks something I say is unpleasant, you can say it to your face, don't whisper behind your back."

The classroom was quiet for a second.

Someone whispered: "So cool."

The corner of Fang Yuan's mouth moved, and it was unclear whether he wanted to laugh or sigh."Sit down."

Su Niannian sat back and turned to raise an eyebrow at An Huai.

An Huai gave her a thumbs up.
